MicBridge Audio — modified BlackHole driver, 2026-11-10

Upstream: https://github.com/ExistentialAudio/BlackHole
Tag: v0.7.1
Commit: e2b22aaaba4e507a097131704bf96dabc004d9cf
License: GPL-3.0; see LICENSE. Original copyright notices are preserved.

Modifications:
- BlackHole/BlackHole.c includes MicBridgeAudioConfig.h and returns the literal
  display name without a channel-count format placeholder.
- The Audio Device transport property reports USB instead of Virtual, following
  the compatibility approach documented by HD838A/remote-mic-app (SayAll).
  This is still a software loopback; it does not use USB hardware.
- Name: MicBridge Audio. UID: MicBridgeAudio2ch_UID. Manufacturer: MicBridge.
- Bundle: org.dji-mic-rxless.MicBridgeAudio. Two channels; default system alerts
  selection disabled. Audio processing remains the upstream implementation.
- BlackHole.plist uses an independent CFPlugIn factory UUID.

Build from the source bundle on a Mac with Xcode:
  bash scripts/build-micbridge-audio-driver.sh
The script defaults to local ad-hoc signing for standalone source rebuilds.
For the combined development package, configure your own code-signing identity
as described in docs/BUILDING.md. Public distribution requires appropriate
Developer ID signing/notarization.

The source archive distributed beside and inside the installer contains this
complete modified source tree and its build script. No network download is
required to rebuild the driver. BlackHole's original installer scripts are
retained as upstream source only; MicBridge uses its own separate installer.
